_comment: Phase R cell spec. One block = every arm below on one host in one repeat. Sizes take bytes or K/M/G/T suffixes. Arm 'code' is the runner's arm (run_arms.sh: C0 T K LM ...; run_arms_sglang.sh: C0 T K) and 'env' its extra settings; the label names the outputs. T2 takes T2_MIN_HITS, T2_DECAY_S and T2_COUNT (layby.vllm.freq_tier); CT needs CT_ETA (layby.continuum.memoryfulness of the measured workload); K_km and K_ewma read surv_km and surv_ewma (layby.curves annotate). hard_cap_s: replay --hard-cap, 3x C0's pilot duration (the runner's REPLAY_TIMEOUT must exceed it by 300 s). 'slots' may replace the top-level cuda/port/park_port/cpus/mems/disk for a node running two engines (GLM, one slot per NUMA half). disk.wipe: fstrim (rm, then fstrim the mount), mkfs (dedicated disk.device), ram (a tmpfs of ram_tier_bytes at disk.mount, regime fast). disk.probe_dir: where the 10% health probe runs (default the mount; give the NVMe volume for a RAM tier). io_max applies to the whole-disk device under disk.mount (or disk.device). capacities.disk_bytes: the disk tier's capacity (2 P: LMCache's L2 cap and SGLang's file evictor cap; vLLM's fs tier has no bound, so an arm whose tier grows past it is invalid). kv_chunk_bytes (required): the tier's chunk, the random-read size of the regime probe. live_scoring (needed by arm K): the replay's side file and the Layby-Dwell release, paths where the engine runs; the sidecar's RSS (pilot sidecar_rss_bytes) is added to K's memory.max. Capacities and CT_ETA: from capacities.json next to the workloads (qwen3_8b.measured; GPU KV floored at one max-length request, 32,768 tokens, because 0.15 P = 29,738 tokens cannot start vLLM). PLACEHOLDER values: rss and the io.max rate come from the pilot.
